message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fluent-bit && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/internal/fuzzers/msgpack_to_gelf_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":7,"var":"data,size","code":"if (size != 512) return 0;","note":"The fuzzer only forwards exactly 512 bytes of attacker-controlled input into the vulnerable conversion path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/internal/fuzzers/msgpack_to_gelf_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"fields.short_message_key","code":"fields.short_message_key = flb_sds_create(\"AAAAAAAAAA\");","note":"The harness sets a non-default short_message key so the input map must contain that key name to satisfy GELF conversion."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/flb_pack_gelf.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_gelf","line":770,"var":"buf_size","code":"ret = msgpack_unpack_next(&result, buf, buf_size, &off);","note":"The raw msgpack bytes are unpacked into a msgpack_object tree that preserves attacker-controlled map keys and values."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/flb_pack_gelf.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_gelf","line":781,"var":"result.data","code":"tmp = flb_msgpack_to_gelf(&s, &result.data, tm, fields);","note":"The unpacked root object is handed to the GELF serializer for field-by-field processing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/flb_pack_gelf.c","function":"flb_msgpack_to_gelf","line":523,"var":"short_message_key_found","code":"else if ((key_len == short_message_key_len) && !strncmp(key, short_message_key, short_message_key_len)) {","note":"A map key matching the configured short_message key is recognized and marked as present, allowing the record to pass the required-field check."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/flb_pack_gelf.c","function":"flb_msgpack_to_gelf","line":540,"var":"v","code":"if (v->type == MSGPACK_OBJECT_MAP) { ... tmp = flb_msgpack_gelf_flatten(s, v, ...); }","note":"Nested attacker-controlled map values are recursively flattened into the output string, expanding the amount of data read from the input object graph."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/flb_pack_gelf.c","function":"flb_msgpack_to_gelf","line":740,"var":"short_message_key_found","code":"if (short_message_key_found == FLB_FALSE) { flb_error(...); return NULL; }","note":"The serializer requires the short_message field before emitting GELF, so the crafted input must include it to reach the sink."},
  {"step":8,"file":"plugins/out_gelf/gelf.c","function":"cb_gelf_flush","line":257,"var":"s","code":"tmp = flb_msgpack_to_gelf(&s, &map, &tm, &(ctx->fields));","note":"The resulting GELF string is produced and later sent; the crash hypothesis is that malformed nested msgpack content triggers an out-of-bounds read during serialization."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
